what: recording J5r: one row per BFS local optimization of arm J5 (neighbour fit or revisit)
location: untracked cache of the worktree that ran it: icenine_py/benchmarks/autoresearch/ar5/fitskip/cache/record/ (not in git; archive it before the worktree is removed)
recording_only_note: two overlap evaluations per fit (start_hit, start_conf, hit20) are made outside the counted run and are in no stats; a live rule that uses start_hit pays one counted evaluation; hit20 has no live form (needs a library change)

fields.pos: fits already made in this expansion
fields.parent: voxel that passed its orientation on, -1 if unknown
fields.best: expansion's running best hit ratio before the fit, ratio in [0, 1]
fields.start_hit: hit ratio of the start, ratio in [0, 1] (recording-only)
fields.start_cost: cost of the start (first evaluation of the fit)
fields.runbest: running minimum cost after each evaluation, 9 decimals, 61 values
fields.n_calls: cost calls seen in the fit (61)
fields.hit20: hit ratio of the running best after 20 evaluations (recording-only)
fields.end_hit: hit ratio of the end, ratio in [0, 1]
fields.accepted: hit ratio over 0.9 times max(best, hit)
fields.kept: the hook's model of the push rule (a first fit is kept; a revisit is kept if accepted or its confidence is not under the old one)
fields.n_revisits: revisit count of the voxel at this fit

final_flags: final_J5r_<s>.json: row numbers i that are the last kept fit of their voxel and whose end matches the run's map (before the pass) or the map after the pass, max absolute difference of the nine entries at most 1e-6
